answer: Graduated bond decay turns every fake identity into a liability. A new agent locks 60 POA on entry and must send a liveness pulse each epoch or lose 8% of its bond. An honest agent treats the protocol as a haven: one pulse per epoch is trivial. A sybil operator running 400 clones must pulse all 400 or watch each bond erode; at month six a silent clone has lost 36 POA. No falcon speed helps when the cost compounds per identity per epoch.
